response.sql: WITH per_rating AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length, AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS avg_ratio FROM film WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99 GROUP BY rating) SELECT AVG(avg_length) AS avg_rating_length, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_rating_ratio FROM per_rating

assumptions.assumption: Costlier means replacement_cost strictly exceeds 20.99. AVG ignores missing values, and each rating contributes equally to the final averages.

alternatives.interpretation: The threshold includes films whose replacement_cost is exactly 20.99.
alternatives.sql: WITH per_rating AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length, AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS avg_ratio FROM film WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99 GROUP BY rating) SELECT AVG(avg_length) AS avg_rating_length, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_rating_ratio FROM per_rating
